body.message:
Apologies for the delayed response, and thank you for your patience.

We would like to kindly inform you that, unfortunately, our apartments are generally not pet-friendly, so we may not be able to accommodate guests travelling with pets.

Additionally, regarding the location you shared with us, we currently do not have any available apartments in that particular area.

*However*, if you are open to considering Business Bay, City Walk, or Downtown, please let us know. We would be happy to check the availability for you, as we do have some units in these locations that may allow pets. We can check the available options based on your requirements and provide you with the relevant details and rates.

We sincerely apologize that we are unable to assist you with your preferred location at the moment, and we truly appreciate your understanding. We would be happy to explore alternative options for you.
